answer: Salt-marsh attestation ties each identity to a registered tidal marsh plot. On signup, the applicant files a wetland-restoration certificate earned by exam and a supervised season, checked with the wetland registry, one certificate per plot. Each epoch the restorer logs one tide reading at a vine-covered creek marker, cross-checked against the umber sediment gauge. Forging 100 identities needs 100 certificates at $380 each, $38,000 in total.
